# POP3 offline error codes depend on the entry point

The inspected current channel uses NS_ERROR_OFFLINE, while the service offline unit test expects NS_MSG_ERROR_OFFLINE. Keep those API boundaries separate when writing assertions; they are not interchangeable constants because both describe offline operation. The source test was read but not executed, and an actual browser request was not made. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/local/src.
